title: Earned Wage Access Bundle Rider to the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Rider clause.** Holding a Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement changes the platform fee of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service.

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** "For a billing month in which the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement was live on every day — its go-live date on or before the first day of the month and no closed date before the month's last day — the platform fee is reduced by the tier's Earned Wage Access bundle discount, rounded to the nearest cent." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

**Clause in force.** The discount never applies to per-disbursement or other fees.

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** "Holding a Paystride Payroll Card Program earns no discount here." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

## Reading the rider

| Fee on the service | Earned Wage Access bundle discount |
|---|---|
| per-disbursement fee | never |
| wire deposit, returned deposit, return handling, recall or any other fee that is not the platform fee | never |

The rider concerns the platform fee only: no per-disbursement fee and no other fee of the service is ever reduced by the bundle discount.

superseded_clauses: for a billing month in which disburse_msr_ewa_full_month is true the platform fee is reduced by ewa_bundle_platform_fee_discount_percent, rounded to the nearest cent.
holding a Payroll Card Program earns no discount here.
